feedback: Repair owner and case modeling: asBuiltPlateThickness, steelMaterialClass, and steelStrengthCategory are asserted on steelGradeRequirementCase although their supplied requiredOwner is ship; place each required fact on its authoritative owner without violating its canonical domain, resolving the inconsistent case/ship representation rather than duplicating facts. Also replace sh:equals between hasSteelGradeRequirementCase and hasTableLookupCase with the declared case relationship/model so independent cases are not incorrectly forced into identical value sets; ensure the Table 8 selection, its inputs, and the actual-versus-required grade comparison apply to the same supplied case.

Remove the sh:or branch permitting sh:maxCount 0 for nltl:hasSteelGradeRequirementCase: it creates an undocumented absence/non-applicability pass and omits the declared requirement-case and Table 8 lookup relationship. Require at least one steelGradeRequirementCase and retain validation that each such case is the same nltl:hasTableLookupCase node, has Table 8 reference and selection evidence, and compares its actual grade rank against the ship-level required grade.

Remove the node-level sh:class nltl:steelGradeRequirementCase constraint from the ship shape: it incorrectly requires every targeted ship itself to be a steel-grade requirement case. Also remove the needless sh:class nltl:benchmarkEntity constraint unless ship-to-benchmarkEntity typing is independently required. Keep the steelGradeRequirementCase class constraint only on values reached through nltl:hasSteelGradeRequirementCase and validate those case nodes with gs:I2-048-SteelGradeCaseShape.
